programmes.d: Serenity, Duke and Tristan meet up with Big Four, who challenges all three of them to a duel.
Tristan disappears into a lake of fire after his life points are wiped out; Serenity and Duke battle Big Four.
Tristan's mind is trapped in a robot monkey; Kaiba runs into Big 5.
Kaiba must use his most powerful monster, Blue-Eyes White Dragon, against the Big Five; Tristan is still trapped inside the robot monkey.
Kaiba arrives at Noah's sanctuary to rescue Mokuba, who has been manipulated and wants to stay with Noah.
Yugi and Joey face the Big Five.
The Big Five concentrate their attack on Joey in hopes of knocking him out; the Big Five keep switching their Deck Masters to take advantage of each of their unique abilities.
Joey and Yugi battle the Big Five and their Five God Dragon, hoping to defeat them and save Tristan's body.
Noah and Kaiba agree to battle for control of the corporation.
Noah summons dinosaur monsters to do battle with Kaiba's interdimensional dragon.
Mokuba's actions put his relationship with Kaiba in jeopardy.
Yugi takes Kaiba's place in a duel against Noah.
Yugi's friends try to support him during a duel, despite being turned into stone.
After defeating Noah, Yugi learns why he cannot escape from the virtual world.
Yugi and gang are trapped in an underwater base about to be destroyed by a satellite; the gang must rely on help from an enemy, Noah, in order to defeat a horde of monsters.
Yugi and his friends must find a way to escape from the virtual world.
The gang arrives at KaibaCorp Island, and the Battle City finals begin with a four-person duel.
